stories.short_summary: Copart leverages secular total loss frequency expansion and non-insurance channel growth to drive 5.2% revenue CAGR and $2.14B in Owner Earnings. Steady operational execution combined with 2.0% annual share buybacks yields a 9.0% per-share Owner Earnings CAGR to $2.51 by Year 5.

stories.title: Path 2: Cyclical Claims Volume Friction, Consumer Retrenchment & Regulatory AML Drag (Downside Friction Path — 35% Probability)
stories.short_summary: Persistent consumer underinsurance, DOJ regulatory AML compliance friction, and inflating yard operating costs constrain global volume growth to a 0.4% CAGR and compress operating margins to 33.0%. Consequently, per-share Owner Earnings contract from $1.63 to $1.52 over the 5-year period.
